title: Personal Portfolio
description: A personal portfolio website built with React TypeScript and hosted on GitHub Pages to showcase academic and personal projects. Features HashRouter for sub-page routing, MaterialUI for React components, JSON-driven content management, and dynamic CSS for responsive PC and mobile layout.
content: Built with React TypeScript; hosted on GitHub Pages
Implemented HashRouter for sub-page routing and MaterialUI for React components
Applied flexible content management via JSON storage
Dynamic CSS for responsive PC and mobile layout

title: Hong Kong Bus Tracker
description: A web app for tracking estimated bus arrival times in Hong Kong, built with React TypeScript and Next.js. Integrates the public Data.gov.hk API for live ETA data, implements i18n supporting 3 languages, and uses session storage to persist user configuration and preferences.
content: Built with React TypeScript and Next.js
Integrated public Data.gov.hk API for live bus ETA data
Implemented i18n supporting 3 languages (English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese)
Used session storage to persist user configuration and preferences across sessions
